summary: Dynamic Aerospace Systems Corp filed an 8-K reporting three private transactions: (1) issuance of a $275,000 convertible promissory note to LABRYS FUND II, L.P. with 8% interest, OID, conversion at lower of $0.50 or 80% of 15-day VWAP, and warrants for 199,275 shares at $0.65; (2) issuance of 20,000 commitment shares; (3) issuance of 500,000 shares to advisor Tyler Troup. These are routine financings and share issuances, not a special situation. No merger, tender offer, spin-off, or structural change occurs. Watch for dilution from conversion and warrants.
